// L0 SUBSTRATE · HAVEN OF AFFINITY peer-to-peer · chartered AI

One master DID, parallel identities, dual tracks

Havix derives four unlinkable parallel identities from a single master DID — one person, four context personas that cannot be correlated from outside. Across them runs a credit-and-value dual economy: reputation accrues as long-term credit, while credits circulate as consumable value — every issuance frozen against equal reputation, every arbitration settled by slashing it. This is also where AI gains its license: a living charter lets AI manage Aether's Spark reserve and keep liquidity flowing to Engine, while red lines force anything dangerous onto a human, on-chain vote.

01 / IDENTITY FOUR CONTEXTS, ZERO LINKAGE

One soul, four unlinkable faces

Every node derives four context sub-DIDs from one root. Work cannot follow you into play; a market dispute cannot stain your social identity. Cross-context linkage is cryptographically absent — not merely discouraged.

02 / ECONOMY REPUTATION ⇄ CREDIT

Two ledgers, one honesty engine

Reputation is earned and can be frozen as collateral; credit notes are issued against it, double-signed and replay-proof. Misbehavior is slashed by juror verdict — not by a platform's whim.

Let an AI touch the reserve? Only through this gate.

Havix licenses AI to manage Spark liquidity for Aether — inside a living charter. Click any action below and watch the charter decide: routine operations execute instantly with receipts; red-line operations are physically routed to a human, on-chain vote.

WHY "LIVING" CHARTER The charter itself is versioned and governed — amended through Aether's chambers, never unilaterally. AI capability grows by earning scope, not by seizing it: autonomy is a grant that can be narrowed.

05 / ROADMAP

From kernel to a garden of apps

M8.1
PersistenceEight ledgers survive restarts with atomic writes — reputation, credit, vouches, wiki index, disputes, treasury, markets, nonces.
M8.2
CLI + local web panelA 43-command REPL plus a localhost-only, GET-only topology dashboard (vis-network). Mutations stay on the CLI; the panel can never be remote-controlled.
M8.3
4-node integrationReal multi-node e2e: vouch propagation, wiki announcements, credit mirroring and restart recovery across a star topology.
M9.6
Security hardening — doneDeep audit closed all 15 findings (6 P0 / 6 P1 / 3 P2). The protocol enters the SDK phase with a clean bill.
M10
App SDK + validation experiment — concludedA public SDK lets Engine-class apps plug into identity, credit and vouching. Its validation experiment — a peer translation market (Embas) — proved escrow delivery, arbitration payouts and DID de-identification run end-to-end on the protocol, on a 1,174-test baseline (MVP 980 + experiment 194). The M10 deep audit then surfaced 52 findings (5 P0 + 15 P1 + 32 P2); P0/P1 were remediated before closed beta, the 32 P2 items are scheduled for M11. Findings settled into the protocol; the experiment itself has been withdrawn from the loop. The network now stands validated, on standby.
L1
Germ — the Brain, laterNode-level AI on the network, reasoning with its own identity. Engine is today's market entry; Germ is the future stage the loop grows toward.
THE ABSTRACTION IS THE ARCHITECTURE Nobody using the loop ever "sees" Havix, Aether or a chain. They chat, unlock with a fingerprint, subscribe to Spark — and sovereignty happens underneath. That is what chain abstraction means here: not hiding the chain from devs, but from everyone.
